samples.name: 01 · Hello Rect
samples.description: The smallest patch — one shape wired to the Renderer. Start here.

samples.name: 02 · Colour & Fill
samples.description: Colour a shape with the Color → Fill → Rect chain.

samples.name: 03 · Animate with Time
samples.description: Drive a shape's position with time/seconds → Math (sin) → Math (multiply).

samples.name: 04 · Follow the Mouse
samples.description: Wire input/mouse into an ellipse — the shape tracks the cursor.

samples.name: 05 · Slider Control
samples.description: A slider drives the rect's width — the basic interactive control.

samples.name: 06 · Spreads & ForEach
samples.description: Generate a list with Range Spread, iterate over it with a ForEach to draw N shapes.

samples.name: 07 · Grid of Dots
samples.description: Grid Spread emits one vec2 per cell — each one wires straight into an ellipse → 8×8 grid.

samples.name: 08 · Palette Colours
samples.description: Palette + Cycle Spread → colour a grid of dots from a 4-stop palette.

samples.name: 09 · State (per-frame memory)
samples.description: A state/value counter incremented every frame drives a rotating hue.

samples.name: 11 · Polar Coordinates
samples.description: sin/cos × radius gives any point on a circle — the foundation of radial layouts.

samples.name: 12 · Circle of Shapes
samples.description: Ring Spread + ForEach lays N evenly-spaced shapes on a ring.

samples.name: 13 · Map: Remap Ranges
samples.description: math/map converts one numeric range to another — mouseX → hue across the rainbow.

samples.name: 14 · Lerp Two Colours
samples.description: color/lerp blends colour A → B by t. sin(time) gives a smooth oscillation between them.

samples.name: 15 · Style Chains
samples.description: Wire one style into another's `base` to layer fills + strokes on a single shape.

samples.name: 16 · Group + Transform
samples.description: transform/group collapses many layers into one; transform/rotate spins the whole assembly.

samples.name: 17 · Perlin Noise
samples.description: Smooth random — neighbouring inputs give neighbouring outputs. Drives y and hue per cell.

samples.name: 18 · Random Spread
samples.description: random/uniform seeded per-index → 80 deterministically-placed ellipses. Change seed to reroll.

samples.name: 19 · If Region (Conditional)
samples.description: region/if runs its body only when its condition is true. sin(time) > 0 toggles it, so the rect blinks on and off.

samples.name: 20 · Subpatch (Reusable Box)
samples.description: meta/subpatch wraps a sub-graph behind custom ports — double-click to descend, edit, climb back out.

samples.name: 21 · Trails (Write*/Read*)
samples.description: Append mouse position to a running spread each frame; draw the buffer as a Path.

samples.name: 22 · Cache Region
samples.description: A Cache region skips recompute when inputs are stable — wrap expensive work inside.

samples.name: 23 · Polygon from Points
samples.description: draw/polygon turns a Spread<vec2> into ONE shape — no ForEach needed.

samples.name: 24 · Path with Tension
samples.description: draw/path tension > 0 turns segments into smooth Catmull-Rom curves; sin(time) breathes between sharp and smooth.

samples.name: 25 · Spring-follow Mouse
samples.description: Two state slots (pos + vel) + Hooke + damping — the dot trails the cursor with springy delay.

samples.name: 26 · Rasterize (Layer → Image)
samples.description: image/from-layer converts a vector layer into a bitmap; the bitmap is then drawn back via draw/image.

samples.name: 27 · Image Sampling Grid
samples.description: image/sample-spread reads N colours at N points — recolour a 24×24 grid of squares from a rasterised gradient.

samples.name: 28 · Audio-Reactive Visual
samples.description: Mic → amplitude → drives circle size. Allow microphone access when asked.

samples.name: 29 · Oscillator (mouse-pitched)
samples.description: sound/oscillator + sound/output; mouseY → frequency. Move the cursor to slide the tone.

samples.name: 30 · Keyboard Branching
samples.description: Two If regions gated on input/keyboard.key — press R for red rect, B for blue ellipse.

samples.name: 31 · Vec2 Math
samples.description: Operate on vec2 as one unit with Vector Math (scale) — no splitting and recombining.

samples.name: 32 · Normalize + Polar
samples.description: Vector Math's normalize gives a unit-vector direction; scale it to any length.

samples.name: 33 · Gradient Sampling
samples.description: color/gradient interpolates between palette stops; mouseX picks the colour.

samples.name: 34 · Draw Text
samples.description: draw/text is just a draw node — pos, size, style — with a string param.

samples.name: 35 · Wanderer (random drift)
samples.description: random/wanderer2d gives a vec2 that drifts smoothly with time — natural motion.

samples.name: 36 · Gaussian Scatter
samples.description: random/gaussian clusters samples around a mean — bell-curve placement.

samples.name: 37 · Image from URL
samples.description: io/image-url fetches an image; draw/image displays it. Picsum returns a fresh photo per seed.

samples.name: 38 · Image Adjust
samples.description: Image filters chain like styles — brightness, contrast, saturation, hue.

samples.name: 39 · Pixelate
samples.description: image/pixelate downsamples-then-upsamples for a chunky retro look.

samples.name: 40 · Pixel Sort
samples.description: pixel/sort reorders pixel runs by brightness — classic datamosh / glitch-art look.

samples.name: 41 · Spread Sort + Shuffle
samples.description: Shuffle Spread, then Reorder set to sort, reorder a Spread<number>; visualised as a bar chart.

samples.name: 42 · Elementary CA
samples.description: spread/elementary-ca advances a 1D boolean row by one Wolfram tick (try rule 30, 90, 110).

samples.name: 43 · Game of Life
samples.description: spread/gol-step + Write*/Read* runs Conway across frames; classic cellular automaton.

samples.name: 44 · Accumulator (Fold)
samples.description: AccRead / AccWrite split pair threads state across ForEach iterations — running sum of 1..10, all wires LTR.

samples.name: 45 · MIDI CC
samples.description: input/midi-cc reads a Control Change knob (already mapped 0..1). Drives rect size.

samples.name: 46 · Sound Filter Sweep
samples.description: sound/filter biquad on a saw; mouseX sweeps the cutoff frequency — classic synth tone.

samples.name: 47 · ADSR Envelope
samples.description: sound/envelope shapes amplitude over time (attack / decay / sustain / release). Mouse press = gate.

samples.name: 48 · Pulse Width Drone
samples.description: sound/pulse with sin-driven width creates moving timbres; circle breathes with amplitude.

samples.name: 49 · FFT Spectrum Bars
samples.description: sound/fft outputs a spectrum spread; 128 bars track mic input. Grant microphone permission.

samples.name: Kinetic Wave
samples.description: Cavalry-style traveling wave: rows × characters laid out with sin(time + charPhase − rowDelay). Per-word colour from a palette.

samples.name: Halo
samples.description: A phrase laid around three concentric rings that spin, the inner ones faster. Hue cycles per character and per time for a chromatic chase.

samples.name: The Raven
samples.description: A passage from Poe’s “The Raven” as a serif grid. Each letter fades in and out on its own Perlin walk in black & white, blurring as it dims.

samples.name: Noise Drift
samples.description: A passage as a monospace grid. A slow Perlin mask picks drifting clusters of letters; inside them a noise field shoves and tints the type while the rest stays readable.

samples.name: Type Rain
samples.description: Matrix-style falling characters — every column scrolls at its own noise-seeded speed, and letters dim as they fall down the canvas.

samples.name: Weight Wave
samples.description: A wave of weight and width rolls through a stack of rows in a variable font (style/font-variations); every row reflows at its own axis values.

samples.name: Spiral Type
samples.description: text/on-path: a phrase scrolls along a spiral and a ring, each glyph turned to the path’s tangent.

samples.name: Glyph Particles
samples.description: text/outline samples the letterforms’ contours; particles are born on them while the font’s weight breathes.

samples.name: Write-On Lettering
samples.description: Trim Path (sequence) writes a word's glyph outlines one after another, with a pen nib riding the drawing end.

samples.name: Kinetic Type
samples.description: Text Animate: letters rise, turn and fade in one after another; a second line rides a rolling sine wave. No ForEach.

samples.name: Fountain
samples.description: The "hello, particles" patch — point emitter, gravity from the world, drag for terminal velocity, wrap-bounds keep the canvas cycling.

samples.name: Text Dust
samples.description: particles/from-layer rasterises the wired text shape and samples inside the glyph alpha mask — particles spawn from the actual letterforms.

samples.name: Attractor Field
samples.description: Turbulence + drag + attractor wired into the world. The attractor's viz output draws its influence ring straight into the renderer.

samples.name: Polygon Pinball
samples.description: An octagonal arena wired into BOTH the renderer (visible) AND collider/from-layer (deflective). Edge-normal bounce, not centroid approximation.

samples.name: Galactic Spiral
samples.description: Verlet integrator + vortex + central pull = long stable spirals. Per-particle trails carry the buffer colour so each filament keeps its hue.

samples.name: Lissajous Threads
samples.description: A 240-dot Lissajous curve. Two sliders pick the X/Y frequency ratio; time drifts the phase.

samples.name: Kaleidoscope
samples.description: A drifting window into a photo, drawn as 12 wedges around the centre with every other wedge mirrored. The window wanders with time.

samples.name: Grid Art
samples.description: 6×6 grid of stochastic walker-cluster cells, each independently seeded — 36 unique compositions sharing one palette. Slider re-rolls the whole grid. The walker algorithm (spawn, drift, tapering trails) lives inside draw/walker-cluster.

samples.name: Motion Lab
samples.description: A swaying target tracked by Smooth (lags), Spring (overshoots/resonates), and DelayLine (phase-shifted) in separate lanes against a shared guide — the difference is visible at a glance.

samples.name: Eased Stagger
samples.description: A row of dots bobbing in a travelling wave — the travel comes from the ForEach delay pin (per-item clock offset), the bob from a Motion ease curve, and hue from the fraction loop var.

samples.name: LFO Motion
samples.description: LFOs animating size, colour and position: one LFO with a count of 12 ripples a row of bars, a triangle sweeps the hue, a smooth-random wanders a dot.

samples.name: Phyllotaxis
samples.description: A sunflower spiral placed by the golden angle, driven entirely by the ForEach index / fraction loop vars + polar vec2/from-angle. Hue sweeps with fraction.

samples.name: Smoothed Path
samples.description: A jagged noise polyline with a smoothed overlay — a 3-point box blur using spread/neighbor (broadcast the spread, read left/right via the index pin) inside a ForEach.

samples.name: Grid Ripple
samples.description: A grid of stroked squares offset by a radial sin ripple, driven through a ForEach with per-iteration delay. Stroke colours cycle a palette across the cells.

samples.name: Curl Flow
samples.description: A grid of streaks aligned to a divergence-free curl-noise field that drifts with time — the classic swirling flow-field look.

samples.name: Ripple Field
samples.description: A 25×25 grid of dots, each pulsed by sin(dist_from_center − time). Concentric ripples.

samples.name: Noise Wave
samples.description: A 32×32 grid of cells displaced and hue-shifted by aggressive multi-octave Perlin noise. Pure function of time.

samples.name: Force Field Arrows
samples.description: A 14×14 grid of arrows pointing along a Perlin angle field that drifts with time. Each tip dot is hue-coded.

samples.name: Pendulum
samples.description: Classic pendulum — angular acceleration = −(g/L)·sin(θ), velocity damped each tick. State<number> for θ and ω. NOC §3.

samples.name: Wind & Gravity
samples.description: Mouse-X drives wind; gravity pulls down. F = m·a, so heavier masses respond less to wind. Slide the mass to feel the asymmetry. NOC §2 — forces.

samples.name: Drag
samples.description: Quadratic fluid drag (−c·|v|·v) opposes motion as the ball falls. The terminal-velocity hover is the punchline — gravity and drag balance at constant speed. NOC §2.

samples.name: Mouse Attraction
samples.description: A mover is pulled toward the mouse cursor via a gravity-like inverse-square force, clamped at close distances. Damping keeps it from blowing up. NOC §2.

samples.name: Spring
samples.description: Hooke's law: F = −k·y (at rest at y = 0), plus gravity and damping. State<number> for y and v_y. A bob oscillates beneath a hanging point. NOC §3.

samples.name: Seek
samples.description: Reynolds' classic seek: desired = normalize(target - pos)·maxSpeed, steer = limit(desired − vel, maxForce), vel += steer. Two sliders tune the agent. NOC §5 — autonomous agents.

samples.name: Flow Field
samples.description: A 16×16 grid of arrows whose angles come from Perlin noise that drifts with time. Slider tunes noise scale. NOC §5 — fields driving motion.

samples.name: Fractal Tree
samples.description: The Nature of Code recursive tree, four levels deep: each branch splits in two, ±0.5 rad and 0.7× as long. The recursion's 15 branches (start, end, stroke weight) sit in five number spreads, zipped through one ForEach → one draw/line per branch. NOC §8.

samples.name: Shader · Raymarched Gyroid
samples.description: What a single fragment shader can do: a raymarched 3D scene with melting metaballs carved by a gyroid lattice, soft shadows, ambient occlusion, iridescent fresnel and a glowing grid floor. The Scale slider sets the lattice density.

samples.name: Shader · Plasma
samples.description: A generative GPU fragment shader (gpu/shader) — a classic animated plasma driven by iTime, with a `scale` uniform steered by a slider. Select the node and edit the GLSL in the side panel.

samples.name: Shader · Feedback Ripples
samples.description: A self-feedback fragment shader: each frame diffuses + fades its previous output (iChannel1) and injects a moving source — reaction-diffusion-style ripples that accumulate. Shows the GPU feedback buffer.

samples.name: Shader · Reaction-Diffusion
samples.description: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion on a multi-buffer shader: Buffer A holds the chemical field (reads its own previous frame), the Image pass colour-maps it. The canonical multi-pass GPU case — give it a few seconds to bloom.

samples.name: Fractal Tree (generative)
samples.description: The recursion lives IN the graph — no baked coordinates. One ForEach walks 8 root-to-tip paths × 4 levels with three scalar accumulators (angle, x, y) as a turtle: back to the root at each trunk, turning ±0.5 rad by the path's bits, 0.7× shorter per level. A Sublist set to keep-where keeps each of the 15 branches once. Edit the turn (Map), the shrink (0.7) or the trunk (140) and the tree reshapes.

samples.name: Datamosh
samples.description: Load an image, layer it 4× with RGB-tinted copies at time-driven offsets and blend modes (add / subtract) for a chromatic-aberration glitch.

samples.name: Photo Mosaic
samples.description: Samples a 32×32 grid of pixels from a loaded image and draws each as a dot sized by luminance. Pointillist / Warhol effect that breathes with time.

samples.name: Webcam Mosaic
samples.description: A live, mirrored webcam halftone. Flip the Toggle into the camera's `start` pin and grant permission; each cell becomes a yellow circle where the image is light or a blue square where it is dark (luminance threshold via logic/select).

samples.name: Body Tracking
samples.description: Live MediaPipe skeleton from the webcam. One Toggle starts the camera + the input/landmarks tracker; cyan lines draw the connection edges and yellow dots the points. Switch hands / face / pose on the Landmarks node.

samples.name: Video Pixelate
samples.description: A looping video file (video/file) through image/pixelate into draw/image. Click Replace… on the Video File node to play your own MP4 / MOV; wire a 0..1 number into `scrub` to scrub.

samples.name: Pixel Sort
samples.description: Classic glitch art: sorts maximal runs of pixels along each row by brightness, masked by a (lo, hi) range. Drag the sliders to shift the streaks.

samples.name: Tone Surface
samples.description: Move the mouse — X picks pitch, Y picks amplitude. A 20×20 grid lights up around the cursor.

samples.name: FFT Bloom
samples.description: An oscillator → FFT → polar plot. Each of 64 bins becomes a dot on a ring; mouse Y drives the source pitch.

samples.name: Random Walk Trail
samples.description: A walker drifts via hashed (time, seed) angles, leaving a 200-point colored trail. Hue cycles along the trail; oldest points fade. Uses state/spread.

samples.name: Paint Trail
samples.description: Move the mouse to paint. image/from-layer + state/value accumulate each brush stroke on an offscreen canvas — infinite paint with a hue that cycles over time.

samples.name: Echo Trails
samples.description: Echo keeps the last frames on the GPU: a swinging star leaves ten fading copies. Try trails, delay, slit-scan, freeze.

samples.name: CSV Bar Chart
samples.description: Inline CSV → number spread → 16 colored bars. Edit the `data` param on the CSVInline node to load a new series.

samples.name: Local Peaks
samples.description: Noise bars where each lights green only if it is taller than BOTH neighbours — local-maximum detection with spread/neighbor inside a ForEach.

samples.name: Number Counters
samples.description: Format Number: an eased count-up as money, percent and compact 12.3k, and a m:ss.ff clock.

samples.name: Voronoi Mosaic
samples.description: Poisson-disc points → Voronoi cells with gaps, filled from a palette → corners smoothed by Path Ops. A new seed, a new mosaic.

samples.name: L-System Plant
samples.description: A bracketed L-system (X → F+[[X]-X]-F[-FX]+X, F → FF) grown five times and drawn by a turtle; jitter makes it organic, an LFO sways it.

samples.name: Contour Blobs
samples.description: Random circles merged by Shape Boolean, then offset in and out by Path Ops inside a ForEach — topographic rings around one blob.

samples.name: Plexus
samples.description: Connect Points joins nearby boids with lines that fade and thin as they stretch, a few links per bird.

samples.name: Morph Tunnel
samples.description: Shape Morph blends a circle into a star; 22 copies at rolling t, shrinking and turning, breathe from round to spiky.

samples.name: Relaxed Cells
samples.description: The same random points before and after Scatter's relax (Lloyd relaxation): clumps and gaps become an even mosaic.

samples.name: Loop Bloom
samples.description: A ring of dots breathing in a travelling wave, built on the Time node's loop phase so it repeats perfectly every 5 s — export one loop as MP4 or GIF (File → Export Video / GIF…) and it plays on repeat without a seam.

samples.name: Flocking
samples.description: Simulation in flocking mode: 300 boids separate, align and cohere on a wrapping field. Sliders reshape the flock live; the mouse herds it.

samples.name: Slime Mould
samples.description: Simulation in physarum mode: 20 000 agents lay and follow a trail map that grows into veins. The trail map is an image, coloured by a palette ramp; the mouse feeds it.

samples.name: DLA Coral
samples.description: Simulation in dla mode: random walkers stick to a growing cluster and it branches like coral. Lines join each particle to its parent, coloured by growth order.

samples.name: Cloth
samples.description: Simulation in cloth mode: a Verlet spring mesh hung from two corners, blown by gusts. Drag it with the mouse; pull hard and it tears.

samples.name: Gradient Sunset
samples.description: Gradient fills and a mask: a linear sky, a sun graded across its own box, hard-edged repeating gradient stripes that slide down and mask the sun by luminance, and a turning conic-gradient ring.

samples.name: Neon Bloom
samples.description: Post-effects on the GPU: two counter-rotating neon polygons (conic gradient strokes) through a chain of Effect nodes — bloom, chromatic aberration, animated film grain and a vignette. Switch any Effect's mode to try displace, dither or halftone.

samples.name: Variations & Presets
samples.description: A seeded flow field of strokes. Vary (Ctrl/⌘+Shift+R) re-rolls the patch seed for a new picture; the Presets panel recalls Calm or Storm, or morphs between them.

samples.name: Expression Rose
samples.description: A rose curve of 900 dots from three typed formulas — position, colour and size — each run once per value of a spread. The formulas' names become pins (petals comes from a slider) and t animates them.

samples.name: Cellular Warp
samples.description: One Noise node samples a whole 64×64 grid at once: cellular (Worley) noise, F2−F1 for the cell walls, domain-warped by a second noise field and drifting with time, coloured through an OKLab gradient. Switch its mode to perlin, simplex or value.

samples.name: Topographic
samples.description: Contours traces drifting noise on a grid at 14 levels: the lines of a topographic map, slowly shifting.

samples.name: Colour Spaces
samples.description: The same red → blue blend in RGB, OKLab and OKLCH (Lerp's space option), a cosine palette, and a tetradic harmony around a base colour whose hue turns with time (Palette's generator modes).

samples.name: Metaballs
samples.description: Gooey metaballs from Effect modes: blur (gaussian), then threshold on the coverage (channel alpha) so nearby circles melt together, a coverage glow and an inner shadow for depth. Orbiting circles merge and split.

samples.name: Colour Grade
samples.description: Chroma key, then a grade: petals on a green backdrop keyed onto a gradient sky (with spill suppression), then Levels, Curves (colour pins = a curve per channel: cool shadows, warm highlights) and a 3D LUT from a .cube file in a File node.

samples.name: Rainy Night
samples.description: Lens blur turns scattered lights into bokeh discs, motion blur streaks falling rain along its angle, and barrel distortion bulges the frame like a wide lens.

samples.name: Warp Speed
samples.description: A starfield through spin blur (arcs round the centre) and zoom blur (streaks from it), the zoom pulsing with an LFO for a jump to hyperspace.

samples.name: Marble, Wood & Op Art
samples.description: Noise's pattern modes, domain-warped: stripes → marble, rings → wood grain, checker → op art. The panels go through blur, posterize and edges for a topographic map.

samples.name: Path Ops Shapes
samples.description: Six Path Ops modes: round corners, thicken (a spiral stroke outlined), wave, noise and twist deformers (phases looping with Time), and explode (a hexagon's edges pushed apart).

samples.name: Flipbook Sequence
samples.description: Video plays image sequences too: 16 PNG frames of a flower, carried inside the patch, loop at 12 fps, onion-skinned by Echo. Pick one frame of your own numbered run (Floret's PNG-sequence export, say) to play the lot.

samples.name: Layout Bloom
samples.description: Layout arranges a sunflower spiral whose count steps every 1.8 s: the seeds ease to their new places, new ones grow in and the extra ones shrink away, staggered from the centre out.

samples.name: Point Tracker
samples.description: Point Tracker follows three points across a drifting field of dots, frame by frame (pyramidal Lucas–Kanade), from the picture alone; each marker's colour is its confidence, and Echo trails show the paths.

samples.name: Plexus Colours
samples.description: Connect Points colours each line from its two birds: every boid takes a hue from where it flies, and a line blends from one end's colour to the other's.

samples.name: Topo Type
samples.description: Contours in `shape` mode: rings at even distances round a word, filled like the bands of a contour map, each level its own colour from a palette.

samples.name: Stippled Sphere
samples.description: Scatter's `stipple` mode shades a lit sphere and its shadow with 2600 ink dots: they gather where the picture is dark and relax into an even, hand-stippled grain.

samples.name: Time Smear
samples.description: A Shader with `history` on reads the input's past frames: each band of the picture shows a spinning star as it was a different moment ago, a rolling datamosh time smear.

samples.name: Neon Orbits
samples.description: Effect's glow with `blend` add: three neon orbits cross over a dark grid, and where their halos overlap the light adds up instead of covering what's beneath.

samples.name: Camera Slit-Scan
samples.description: The webcam through Echo's slit-scan: each row of the picture comes from a moment further back, so anything that moves stretches and bends. Without a camera, a swinging stand-in shows the effect.

samples.name: Flow Lines
samples.description: Contours' flow mode: evenly spaced streamlines through a noise field, each line a colour from the palette — the plotter-art look, slowly turning with time.

samples.name: Mondrian Splits
samples.description: Cells' subdivide mode: a square split recursively by chance, black gaps between the parts, colours picked at random from a mostly-white palette.

samples.name: Truchet Tiles
samples.description: The Tiles node's truchet mode: quarter-circle tiles turned by noise, so the arcs clump into long meandering loops in two colours.

samples.name: WFC Circuits
samples.description: The Tiles node's wfc mode: wave function collapse over edge-matched pipe tiles, none running off the grid, each tile type in its own colour.

samples.name: Kaleido Slime
samples.description: The Symmetry node's kaleidoscope mode: a slime mould's trail map cut to a wedge and mirrored six times round the centre, a growing lace mandala.

samples.name: Wallpaper Groups
samples.description: The Symmetry node's wallpaper mode: a small turning motif repeated by the p6m plane group on a hexagonal lattice. Pick any of the 17 groups.

samples.name: Differential Growth
samples.description: The Simulation node's growth mode: a ring whose nodes repel and whose edges split as they stretch, folding like coral; edges coloured by age.

samples.name: Reaction Diffusion
samples.description: The Simulation node's reaction mode: Gray–Scott coral growing out of a rasterised word, with presets for mitosis, fingerprints, worms and more.

samples.name: ASCII Cells
samples.description: The Effect node's ascii mode: reaction–diffusion fingerprint ridges redrawn as coloured characters picked by brightness.

samples.name: Palette From Image
samples.description: The Palette node's image mode: a photo's six dominant colours (k-means in OKLab), used to colour a Mondrian beside it.

samples.name: Ecosystem
samples.description: Boids graze on food that regrows: each steers for its nearest ripe item (Simulation's `food`), meals grow the population and hunger thins it — boom and bust in a live chart. Hold the mouse to grow food; sliders for hunger, speed, regrowth, metabolism.

samples.name: Epidemic (SIR)
samples.description: 320 wanderers, susceptible → infected → recovered: each catches it from the nearest infected person (Lookup's `nearest` op) within a radius. Click to infect; sliders for radius, roaming, recovery, waning immunity; lockdown toggle; presets; live chart.

samples.name: Orbital Sandbox
samples.description: Bodies orbiting a binary star, integrated in Read* / Write* state (symplectic Euler). Drag and release to slingshot new bodies in; time-warp and star-separation sliders; Echo trails.

samples.name: Weather Map
samples.description: A drifting pressure field drawn as filled bands and isobars (Contours), with geostrophic wind feeding flow lines, 320 advected particles and a grid of arrows; H and L at the extremes. XY pad moves the storm; sliders for its depth and the wind.

samples.name: Living Clock
samples.description: The real time as a picture (the Clock node): second ticks, minute and hour arcs, the year's days on a spiral, the Moon's actual phase and the date spelled out, over a sky that follows the hour. Time-travel slider, 12/24-hour toggle.

samples.name: Topographic Reaction
samples.description: Reaction–diffusion you paint with the mouse, read as terrain by Contours (filled elevation bands and isolines) and printed on grainy paper. Presets switch the chemistry; a toggle shows the raw chemicals.

samples.name: Plotter Pipeline
samples.description: Flow-field streamlines in three inks, drawn line after line by Trim Path with a pen riding the tip, on paper with a shadow and grain. Sliders for pen width, spacing, field scale and plot speed; Replot; a clean-output toggle for export.

samples.name: Parallax Valley
samples.description: Five noise ridges sliding past at parallax speeds, fading into the sky by distance, with fog bands, a sun and moon on an arc, stars at night and a small flock of birds. Time-of-day and travel sliders; move the mouse to look around.

samples.name: Night City
samples.description: A city from one subdivision: per-block heights, roofs and sun shadows in a ForEach, windows scattered on the roofs, cars as Trim Path pieces circling the blocks and lamps along the streets, blooming after dark. Time-of-day and density sliders; Vary.

samples.name: Seasons Garden
samples.description: L-system plants that grow (Trim Path), sway in the wind and turn with the seasons; autumn leaves and winter snow fall from particle emitters in a windy world. Season and wind sliders, auto-year toggle, Replant.

samples.name: Tile World
samples.description: An island from noise elevation (coloured Cells), wave-function-collapse roads masked to land, Symmetry rosettes for forests and villages, drifting metaball clouds with shadows and a day/night cycle with village lights. Sea-level and time sliders; Vary.

samples.name: Data Story
samples.description: An animated bar-chart race from inline CSV: Partition picks the year, two sorts give the ranks, state eases the bars, a ForEach sums each year for a line revealed by Trim Path, and captions animate in. Play toggle, year stepper, speed slider.

samples.name: Generative Band
samples.description: A self-playing trio — noise-walk melody (MonoSynth, delay, reverb), sawtooth bass, noise hats — and the same numbers drawn: a 16-step ring, note bursts, the melody's spectrum and waveform, through trails and bloom. Sliders for bpm, density, volume; major/minor.

samples.name: Glitch Tracker
samples.description: Generated footage tracked by optical flow (Point Tracker) with a HUD of boxes and links, while the picture goes through Echo slit-scan, chromatic aberration and displacement bursts. Hold the mouse to re-seed the trackers; glitch slider; slit-scan toggle.

samples.name: Generative Poster
samples.description: A Swiss-style poster as rules: Layout grid modules picking shapes, turns and harmony colours from seeded noise, an animated title and a grain or halftone finish. Colour picker, columns slider (modules ease to the new grid), Vary, and presets to morph between.

samples.name: Brush Studio
samples.description: Paint with the mouse on a canvas fed back to itself: keys 1–4 switch ink, ribbon, spray and rainbow brushes, M mirrors every stroke eight ways, C clears.

samples.name: Slingshot Sandbox
samples.description: Press, pull back and let go to fling balls round bumpers, with an aiming arc; G cycles gravity, W bouncing or wrapping walls, C clears, R rain.

samples.name: Flock Herder
samples.description: Hold the mouse to lure a flock of boids (F turns the lure into a scare); keys 1–3 change its character, S scatters it. Plexus lines and trails.

samples.name: Breakout
samples.description: A complete game from nodes: the paddle follows the mouse, click to launch, bricks break into sparks, score, lives and levels. Plays itself until you click.

samples.name: Voronoi Editor
samples.description: Drag points to reshape Voronoi cells, click to add, X to remove, hold L to relax them; D shows the Delaunay triangles, H the hull. Nearest-point picking from Expression + Statistics.

samples.name: Typing Toy
samples.description: Type and each letter drops in with a bounce, a spin and sparks, then bobs on a wave under a rainbow; Keyboard's text mode keeps the string.

samples.name: Kaleidoscope Toy
samples.description: Beads tumble in a round chamber seen through mirrors: drag sideways to turn the tube (gravity turns too) and drop beads; keys 3–9 set the mirrors.

samples.name: Reaction Painter
samples.description: Drag to paint chemical into a live reaction–diffusion dish; keys 1–7 switch coral, mitosis, fingerprints, worms, maze, spots and waves while it runs.

samples.name: MIDI Garden
samples.description: Every MIDI note plants a flower and plays it; CC knobs turn hue, petals, spin and bloom. No MIDI: sliders, keys A–K and clicks stand in.

samples.name: Preset Morph
samples.description: A spirograph to perform: six presets to recall or morph between in the Presets panel, Vary for new phases, the XY pad and a drag to fan the layers.

samples.name: Step Sequencer
samples.description: A 16 × 8 tone matrix: click or drag cells, the playhead plays each lit column through four MonoSynth voices, Mix, filter, delay and reverb. Tempo, tone, scale.

samples.name: Keyboard Synth
samples.description: Play the computer keyboard like a piano (A–K, W E T Y U), Z / X for octaves, mouse for the filter, and an arpeggiator for held chords; sparks and a scope.

samples.name: Hand Theremin
samples.description: Raise a hand to the webcam (or hold the mouse): left–right is pitch, snapped to a scale or gliding, up–down is loudness; rings and a string vibrate with it.

samples.name: Mic Bloom
samples.description: A flower that listens: the microphone's spectrum becomes its petals, bass swells the core, beats send rings out. Plays its own demo loop until the mic is on.

samples.name: Music Box
samples.description: Pins on a turning disc pluck a comb: a noise-composed tune in a scale, three bell voices. Click the disc to add or remove pins, N for a new tune.
